categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two business segments: (1) Vibration/Shock Damping Business - producing rubber damping products for rail transit and building seismic isolation applications; (2) Lithium Chemical Products Business - through subsidiary Jiangsu Changjili New Energy, producing lithium compounds including chloroalkanes, alkyl lithium, and lithium salts for applications in new energy, pharmaceuticals, and advanced materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: For vibration damping products: advanced rubber formulation design, precision mixing technology using high-pressure mixers, calendering processes with strict temperature control (±3°C), and vulcanization using precision-machined molds. For lithium products: continuous catalytic-free production of chloroalkanes, dispersed lithium sand and low-temperature negative pressure reaction technology for alkyl lithium, and DTB crystallization technology for anhydrous lithium chloride production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major Chinese construction and railway groups (China Railway, China Railway Construction, China State Construction, China Communications Construction). End markets include urban rail transit systems, high-speed railways, heavy-haul railways, building seismic isolation applications, and new energy battery, pharmaceutical, and advanced materials industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Primary operations in China with major facilities in Zhejiang Province (headquarters in Tiantai County), Jiangsu Province (Changjili subsidiary), Anhui Province (lithium battery projects), Henan Province, Xinjiang, and Sichuan Province. The company serves customers across China's major urban centers and railway networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. For vibration damping: converts raw rubber materials into finished damping products for rail and construction projects. For lithium products: processes raw lithium materials into specialized chemical compounds for downstream industrial applications in batteries, pharmaceuticals, and materials manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) expanding vibration/damping product portfolio with new applications in building seismic isolation; (2) developing lithium chemical products for new energy battery applications; (3) advancing manufacturing automation and intelligent production systems; (4) pursuing new material innovations including graphene-based products and specialized composites; (5) establishing regional marketing centers and expanding market presence in southwestern and other regions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct product sales of rubber damping products and lithium chemical compounds to construction contractors, railway operators, and industrial manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers at agreed locations. The company operates on a project-based model for rail transit applications and volume-based sales for chemical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In vibration damping: the company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer with comprehensive product types and rich application experience across Chinese rail transit projects. Competition is relatively concentrated among technically advanced firms with high barriers to entry. In lithium chemicals: the company faces competition from larger integrated lithium producers with upstream resource advantages, though it maintains competitive advantages through specialized product quality and technical expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 revenue of approximately 1.507 billion yuan, down 12.39% from 2022 (1.720 billion yuan). The company reported a net loss of 653.6 million yuan in 2023 compared to net profit of 410.1 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to reduced rail transit construction activity and significant decline in lithium product prices. Total assets of 5.27 billion yuan as of end-2023. The company is in a transition phase with significant capital investments in new production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: For vibration damping products: proprietary cone-shaped rubber layer design providing stable low-stiffness characteristics across varying loads, seamless overlapping design enabling fast installation, and comprehensive product range covering multiple track structure applications. For lithium products: high-purity products with low impurities, advanced continuous production technologies, and specialized formulations for demanding applications in batteries, pharmaceuticals, and advanced materials. The company emphasizes quality management, technical innovation, and comprehensive customer service.
